semantics: Rows count based-isomorphism classes. Unresolved means a general categorification decision remains open in the attached release; unassessed means no classification ledger for this census band. Realized means at least one realization, not every categorification has the given structure.

unrestricted_theorem.scope: Unrestricted complex classification: 15 Grothendieck rings; every categorification admits a spherical structure. The sharp bounds are FPdim ≤ 24+12√3 and multiplicity ≤ 6.

rank2.basis: X²=1+nX, n>=0; complex realizations exactly n=0,1

rank3.basis: Five unrestricted categorical Grothendieck rings: four of multiplicity 1 and one of multiplicity 2; see the standalone sphericality and ring-classification manuscript
rank3.proof_status: Independent ring-level necessity proof and sphericality argument in manuscripts/rank3.tex; source includes an exact arithmetic checker.

site_filter: Ranks 2–8 with complete or partial categorification analysis; unassessed census-only bands omitted.
